The Magic Orb

The Great Mage Tka-Rik needs the magic orb to locate Jigran. Island orcs recently stole it from Estera. Retrieving it means fighting through their lands. To reach the islands, lower the bridges using a special gear.

Objectives

Go to Council Mountain

Obtain the gear

Find the magic orb

Collect the magic orb

Locations

Maps
River and Islands
